title: Mail Server
description: RJSF form schema for an organization's outbound mail server. Captures the user-input fields of the canonical OrganizationSmtpConfigurationPayload, the create payload. Server-owned fields are intentionally absent: the id and timestamps, the `status` lifecycle and the delivery counters behind it, and the from-domain proof. So is the administrative on/off, which is a state transition the server can refuse rather than a form value. Field shape, types, enums, and required list MUST stay a subset of meshery/schemas/constructs/v1beta1/organization_smtp/api.yml#/components/schemas/OrganizationSmtpConfigurationPayload; the Go validator at validation/forms_test.go enforces that.

host.title: SMTP Host
host.description: Hostname of the organization's SMTP server.

port.title: Port
port.description: TCP port the organization's SMTP server listens on.

encryption.title: Encryption
encryption.description: STARTTLS upgrades a cleartext connection (typically port 587); TLS opens an implicit TLS connection (typically port 465); None sends in cleartext and is intended only for an internal relay on a trusted network.

authMechanism.title: Authentication
authMechanism.description: Any mechanism other than None requires both a username and a password.

username.title: Username
username.description: Username presented to the organization's SMTP server.

password.title: Password
password.description: Presented to the SMTP server and stored encrypted; never displayed. Required unless Authentication is None. After creation this field is written only by the separate credential-rotation operation, and the redaction sentinel is refused rather than treated as 'leave unchanged'.

fromAddress.title: From Address
fromAddress.description: Address the organization's mail is sent from. Its domain must be verified before mail is routed through this server, and changing it to a different domain resets that verification.

fromDisplayName.title: From Display Name
fromDisplayName.description: Display name shown alongside the from address.

replyToAddress.title: Reply-To Address
replyToAddress.description: Address replies are directed to. Also the address carried when a message falls back to the provider relay.

fallbackToProvider.title: Fall back to the provider mail server on failure
fallbackToProvider.description: When off, this organization owns delivery entirely and a failure is a dropped message, account verification and password recovery included.
